''See also: [[Eurias Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Eurias, also known as the Life-Giver, is a highly potent magical focus and staff composed of pale wood topped with a blue crystal orb. This orb contains the remnants of a [[World Spirit]] from a destroyed ocean planet. As an amplification tool, Eurias excels at large-[[scale]] magic involving life and [[water]], such as summoning massive rainstorms across hemispheres or generating lush vegetation and rivers. However, the staff is better suited for broad environmental manipulation than for precision targeting against single individuals. Its immense [[Aetheric power]] allows it to interact with physical forms and can be used to bolster a mage's magic or facilitate negotiations with other [[World Spirits]]. While it provides significant strength for casting massive spells, such as absolute [[sealing magic]], using the staff prioritizes raw power over fine control.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Eurias is a unique, one-of-a-kind magical focus known as the Life-Giver that serves as [[Varic Vallenar]]'s staff. This object consists of a foot-long rectangle of metal plates containing a crystal branch, featuring smooth pale wood topped with a blue crystal orb that houses the [[spirit]] of an ocean world. As a [[wand]] powered by [[World Spirits]] of life and [[water]], it functions as a focus that draws magic out rapidly while keeping spells ordered and locked onto single targets. The staff can command [[wind]], rainstorms across entire hemispheres, and even cause vines to erupt and bend the world. After being kept in a sealed crate, the [[Iron King]] eventually seized Eurias from its case and released it to take a gigantic form to battle the [[Divine Titan]].}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Eurias is a world-level staff known as the Life-Giver, crafted from the smooth, pale wood of an [[Aethril]] world-tree and constructed from a [[World Spirit]]. The staff is topped with a blue crystal orb that houses the remains of the [[World Spirit]] from the planet Eurias, which shares its name. This tool runs with [[Aetheric power]] capable of interacting with physical forms and is utilized for brute magical work, such as providing the strength for a large-[[scale]] spell or magnifying the [[Mirror of Silence]]. Although it allows for powerful magic, the narrator's casting speed through the staff is slow, and they once suspected an accidental connection to it during a [[Subspace dive]]. Because the object can be broken open and consumes [[Aether]], it must be kept in a case and requires sealing to remain stable.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Eurias is a significant entity to the [[Aether]] with the power to clear out [[Scourge Warrens]]. While casting is notably less potent than if Eurias were performing the magic itself, the entity also functions as a location capable of assisting in travel to another star system. As a blue crystal kept within a protective crystal case, it can be liquefied with a single touch, allowing the material to melt and rise into the narrator's hand.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Eurias is a staff crafted from pale wood and topped with a blue orb that houses the [[World Spirit]] of a destroyed ocean planet. This artifact glows with a blue light and possesses the ability to summon miniature rainclouds. Although it was not brought by the narrator's students, the staff carries a metaphysical weight comparable to a planet and can cast spells from neighboring worlds. During a [[ritual]], the narrator held this item, which possesses a magical weight equivalent to the [[Voice of Solstice]]. Ultimately, Eurias was released when the [[Absolute Burial]] spell was crushed, revealing it to be a planet where one can negotiate with or threaten [[World Spirits]] from orbit.}}
